notes.title: NEON Ultra patch v1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all thanks for all of the support and feedback you have given! 

Today I have released the 1.1 update for NEON Ultra. This update includes the following fixes/changes:

	Fixed an issue where the game would crash when quitting the game.	Fixed an issue where "chaser" enemies could hurt the player as soon as they spawn.	Minor performance tweaks.	Fixed a number of minor issues on the OSX build of the game.	Updated player input and controller support. PS4 Controllers now work on both Windows and OSX. 

Thanks again for all the support!

--
Amy
